objective: Retire remaining compatibility economic consumers from production authority paths and implement Treasury Economic Intelligence as a read-only advisory layer without introducing another economic authority.

rulesConsidered: Intelligence proposes; authority authorizes; runtime executes; evidence proves.
Treasurer remains the sole production economic admission authority.
Ascalon/GLiDE may receive bounded advisory projections but cannot mutate Treasury.

forensicFindings: Legacy quota Firestore remained the admission/read authority in several user-facing and cognitive paths.
CapabilityFirstRouter still referenced CostGovernor as a production cost gate on the pre-Wave branch.
MissionManager still delegated economic budget evaluation to MissionBudgetManager.
Legacy /api/generations contained independent generation/economic logic rather than routing through the canonical generate-video path.
Specialized quiz endpoints contained direct provider fallback paths that could bypass Treasury-managed model admission.
Treasury ledger events required stronger provider/model attribution for trustworthy unit economics.
changes: Added TreasuryEconomicIntelligence as a read-only ledger projection producing measured spend, unit economics, reservation utilization, anomaly signals, capacity pressure, and bounded spend forecasts.
Added TreasuryEconomicAdvice as a capability-free SHADOW_ONLY projection for Overseer/Ascalon/GLiDE advisory context.
Added an authenticated admin-only Treasury Economic Intelligence API and operator page.
Retained provider/model resource attribution on Treasury reservations and economic ledger events.
Moved quota reads/admission to TreasuryQuotaAdmission; legacy Firestore is bootstrap/projection only.
Removed CostGovernor from CapabilityFirstRouter authority decisions.
Removed MissionBudgetManager from MissionManager economic enforcement; lifecycle duration/parallelism remain mission constraints.
Collapsed /api/generations into a compatibility facade for canonical /api/generate-video.
Moved quiz generation specialized provider paths onto Treasury-aware providerFactory/IntelligentRouter execution.
Fed bounded Treasury economic advice into Overseer Decision Fabric shared context.
research: Existing Treasury Wave 1–3 contracts and runtime
Existing F06/F07 verification and settlement boundaries

security.notes: No secrets are included. Production authority remains deterministic Treasury Kernel. Remote CI is required for final validation.

trainingReadiness.authority: Treasury Kernel remains sole economic admission authority; F07 remains verification authority

verificationPlan: Run the repository CI and Team Change Gate workflows on the current branch head.
Run focused Treasury Economic Intelligence and authority-retirement tests.
Run relevant model/API, Compute Pool, F06/F07, Overseer, and governance validation workflows.
Merge only after required blocking validations are green and the branch remains aligned with current main.

conflicts.conflict: Legacy quota vs single Treasury authority
conflicts.resolution: Treasury owns admission/read state; Firestore is bootstrap/projection only.
CapabilityFirstRouter selects candidates only; Treasury admits economic consumption.

conflicts.conflict: Mission lifecycle vs economic budget authority
conflicts.resolution: MissionManager enforces lifecycle duration/parallelism; Treasury owns spend/token/capacity admission.
Intelligence is read-only and emits a SHADOW_ONLY projection; no Treasury mutation handle is exposed.

notes: This wave does not delete compatibility modules prematurely; it removes their production authority roles first.
Provider/model selection remains separate from economic admission.
Forecasts are baseline extrapolations from measured Treasury spend rate, not probabilistic guarantees.
No claim of merge or production readiness is made until current-head remote validation is green.
